* '''Original''' (this page): Virtual Block 2 release sheet, official text as of 7 December 2009 (slip 127)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf Virtual Block 2 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"; surviving copy built 18 December 2009). At same location, your unique (•) Rebels are deploy -1 and their immunity to attrition is +1. Dark Side Republic characters are deploy +2 and forfeit -2. [Immune to Alter]” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB2-127-Leia_Of_Alderaan.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB2-L-leiaofalderaan-pre.gif]]) print it. The Master List (Light Side p. 25)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> reprints it character for character: a stale reprint, not a new version, and it does not make this text current again.
